notes: The family is a real tree now, not a description of one. Settings gains a Relationships page that lays a household out by generation, parents above children, with everyone's ties listed on their card and anyone not yet placed waiting underneath. Tap a person to say who they are to you, how they are referred to, and to link them to anyone else — pick the other character, pick what they are, and the reverse is written for you, so a mother never ends up with a child who thinks they are a sibling. The words come from the link rather than being typed: set someone as a parent and it reads mother or father depending on how they are referred to, and it stays right when anything is renamed. Characters are told these connections outright rather than left to work them out, which matters more the larger a household gets. The starter family arrives already built.
